title: Global ALL events: single lane, fan-out to every regional database
label: after

observations.name: ALL event reaches every regional database exactly once
observations.expected: each price in app-pg-eu, -am and -apac with its event's sequence, applied_events = 1, context ALL
observations.observed: 5 events x 3 databases, each applied once

observations.name: only the global lane writes the catalog
observations.expected: every catalog_price row written by an order-query-global-* replica

observations.name: one ALL lane cluster-wide
observations.expected: exactly one CatalogProjector checkpoint, consumers/order-query_CatalogProjector_1_ALL (the replicas share it)

observations.name: each ALL event fanned out by one replica
observations.expected: every sequence appears in exactly one replica's event=lab_fanout log (standby idle meanwhile)
observations.observed: no sequence processed by both replicas

observations.name: healthy regions during APAC's database outage
observations.expected: the single ALL lane stalls for every region: EU and AM get at most the head event, the checkpoint stays before it (known trade-off of one lane with N targets)
observations.observed: EU/AM received {AM=1, EU=1} of 4 ALL events; lane checkpoint 583 -> 583

observations.name: convergence after healing, no duplicates
observations.expected: every ALL event in all three databases, applied_events = 1 (replays refused by the sequence guard)

observations.name: standby takes over the ALL lane
observations.expected: after the holder dies, order-query-global-apac fans out the next events to all three databases

notes: The lane is one (one consumer id, one lock row); which replica holds it can change between fetch cycles (N4: the JDBC consumer lock is taken per cycle, not sticky).
catalog_price in APAC not readable: Non riesco a trovare un server con il «targetServerType» specificato: primary
A per-target lane (one consumer per regional database) would keep EU and AM current during an APAC outage, at the price of N lanes to operate; the lab keeps one lane on purpose.
